title: A Ruler for Water

method.rationale: After several handoff/intake revisions, the live risk became false readiness around D010. This read pressures poem body weaknesses without fabricating reader evidence.

surviving_hinges: Behind the Marine Inspection Office, / the pier kept a ruler / for water.
A tide staff is honest / only while wet.
No value came back. / Water did.
Only a held zero, / and water passing / without agreement.
residual_risks: Station Datum may still import authority instead of letting scene carry pressure.
Not the tide. / The rule / for saying tide explains too quickly.
Its zero remains. / Height does not closes as concept rather than action.

reader_triggered_decision_rules: If a disclosed reader says the poem works but names Station Datum as the weakest point, draft D011 with no technical noun in the body.
If a disclosed reader says the source note or disclosure does the poem's work, demote D010 from candidate and draft D011 under subtraction constraints.
If a disclosed reader keeps the poem and names No value came back / Water did or the opening ruler image as the strength, keep D010 as candidate but do not admit it from one response.
If no reader response is available, do not build more intake machinery; run the handoff outside the cube or log project-owner override before D011.
non_claim: Internal adversarial candidate read only; not external reader evidence, not admission, not evidence-ready status, and not a poem-quality proof.
